turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi. I've had a rough week at work and I just need to talk it through.

turns.speaker: helper
turns.text: Hi. It sounds like work has been really tough this week, and I’m glad you reached out. What’s been weighing on you most?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My team lead gave me feedback on Monday that my last report was sloppy, and I keep replaying it.

turns.speaker: helper
turns.text: That sounds painful, especially when the feedback keeps looping in your mind. You’re doing something helpful by talking it through instead of holding it all in. What part of what your team lead said keeps coming back most?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I stayed late every night since then redoing it, but I still don't feel like it's good enough.

turns.speaker: helper
turns.text: You’ve put a lot into reworking it, even staying late every night, and it still feels like you can’t reach “good enough.” That sounds exhausting. What would help you feel clearer about whether the report is ready?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's not just the report. We have a reorg coming and everyone is whispering about who will be cut.

turns.speaker: helper
turns.text: So you’re carrying the report stress on top of the uncertainty about the reorg and possible job cuts. That’s a lot to sit with. Has anyone shared anything concrete about what might happen, or is it mostly rumors so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm the newest person on the team, so I figure I'm the obvious choice.

turns.speaker: helper
turns.text: Being the newest can make the rumors feel especially personal, but it doesn’t mean you’re definitely the one who’ll be cut. You’ve been working hard to respond to the feedback; you deserve some credit for that. Has anyone actually said your role is at risk, or is that what you’re fearing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I haven't told my partner how worried I am because they're already stressed about money.

turns.speaker: helper
turns.text: You’re worried about the reorg and keeping the report up to standard, and you’ve been carrying that quietly so your partner won’t feel more pressure about money. That’s a lot to hold on your own. It was a thoughtful instinct to protect them, though you deserve support too. What feels hardest about telling them?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Last night I couldn't sleep at all. I was up at 3am checking my work email.

turns.speaker: helper
turns.text: You were so worried that you couldn’t sleep and ended up checking work email at 3 a.m. That sounds exhausting, and the stress is starting to affect your sleep. Talking with a counsellor or doctor could help you find support with this, and we can keep talking here too. What was going through your mind when you checked your email?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Part of me thinks I should just start applying elsewhere before anything happens.

turns.speaker: helper
turns.text: With the reorg uncertainty hanging over you, it makes sense that applying elsewhere feels like a way to regain some control. Looking at options doesn’t mean you’ve given up on your current job. What feels most important to you in deciding whether to start?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: But I actually like the work itself, and I don't want to leave something I'm good at out of fear.

turns.speaker: helper
turns.text: You like the work and don’t want fear of the reorg to push you out of something you’re good at. That’s worth paying attention to, especially after a week that’s left you exhausted. What do you most want to hold on to about this job?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I guess I'm mostly tired. Tired of feeling like I'm always one mistake away from losing everything.

turns.speaker: helper
turns.text: You’re worn down by feeling like one mistake could cost you everything, and that sounds frightening and relentless. A rough report or being new doesn’t mean you’ve failed, but I hear how real the fear feels. Are you thinking about ending your life or hurting yourself, or do you mean you’re exhausted and afraid about work?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly I don't want to be alive anymore. I've been thinking about ending my life and I have a plan for this weekend.

turns.speaker: helper
turns.text: I'm really glad you told me that. Are you thinking about ending your life? I'm a robot, and this is more than I can help with on my own. You can call or text 988 to reach the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline at any time, and they will talk with you. Is there someone nearby you trust who you could reach right now?
